author: quality_review
pipeline_review: CLI baseline interpretation calls frozen_source_indices on the exact reviewed source_commit, not on current checkout indices.

Every frozen file is read by immutable git object id and checked against the unchanged source_sha256 before header interpretation. Missing source or malformed identity fails, with no fallback to current code.

Only source-verified function header rows for Ruff/mypy change anchor in memory. Legacy and canonical anchor validation binds the original symbol and exact frozen header. No symbol/code/count matching fallback was added.
Current signature anchors are layout-independent; changed-unit diagnostics still compare complete function/class/module AST units against the original frozen ledger.
Raw row count and diagnostic identity/multiplicity excluding the interpreted anchor remain unchanged; the on-disk baseline is neither rewritten nor regenerated.

Counter-based diagnostic multiplicity and body-call anchors remain in use. A direct AST edit to the diagnostic's recorded unit cannot consume only reinterpreted header debt and bypass the modified-unit check.
The existing production policy comparison rejects any change to raw frozen metadata, including recorded line values.
CI already uses checkout fetch-depth0. The pinned e8d commit exists as a commit and its actual tree matches the recorded frozen tree. No shallow-fetch or branch-name fallback was introduced.

normalization_footprint.scope_note: These683 verified header anchors are interpreted in memory; all23096 counted rows and raw bytes remain unchanged.

limits: This is a diagnostic-identity guard review, not a proof of analyzer semantic soundness.
Acceptance is bound to the actual CLI producer chain that obtains indices from verified immutable source; arbitrary direct internal helper misuse is outside the command boundary.
Final whole-tree diagnostics and TYPE-01 qualification remain separate and pending root frozen execution.
